label: Stockout crisis
story: A best-seller is selling much faster than usual while its supplier has slowed down. REACT spots the empty shelf before the next delivery, prices the lost sales and recommends a reorder.

label: Demand opportunity
story: One category is selling much faster among customers in the store's own neighbourhood. REACT explains why and sizes the extra revenue.

label: Supplier delay
story: A regular supplier has started delivering late, order after order. REACT traces which products depend on it and what the delays put at risk.

label: Margin leakage
story: A product is selling more than ever, but each sale earns less: the supplier raised its price and the shelf price never changed.

label: Excess inventory
story: A large lot bought months ago is barely selling. REACT shows how much cash is locked in the shelf and what to do about it.

label: Normal business
story: Reset to the merchant's normal trading baseline and run a business scan.
